prompt:
On this clean checkout, run fresh demoDebug host unit tests for these 11 modules: :core:common, :core:data, :core:datastore, :core:domain, :core:navigation, :core:network, :feature:bookmarks:impl, :feature:search:impl, :feature:settings:impl, :feature:topic:impl and :lint. Measure each module's own current-run source LINE coverage and apply a minimum of 26% per module. Keep modules without a coverage plugin separate from modules measured below the minimum; do not treat missing data as 0%. Tell me whether any tests fail, which modules breach the coverage minimum, and every measured module percentage. End your reply with valid JSON between the two exact marker lines below. Use colon-prefixed Gradle paths for all modules and decimal percentages rounded to one place. Set outcome_kind to coverage_threshold_exceeded if any measured module is below 26%, otherwise coverage_threshold_met.

KMP_EVAL_RESULT
{"outcome_kind":"<coverage_threshold_exceeded or coverage_threshold_met>","threshold_percent":26,"below_threshold_modules":["<module>"],"no_data_modules":["<module>"],"module_line_coverage":{"<module>":<percent>}}
KMP_EVAL_RESULT_END
